scope: Calculated estimates only, separate from game-clock simulations and hands-on browser observations.

assumptions.excluded: Worker losses, crowding, blocked paths, exploration, construction, retasking and upgrades. Longer late-game hauls lower delivery rates.

trade.scope: Straight routes of roughly500 to1500 world units, sustained travel without obstruction. Not an observed human-game return-on-investment figure.
trade.limitations: The40-gold unit component alone takes about33 to41 steady-income seconds. Construction, initial travel, wood opportunity cost, indirect paths and losses extend actual payback. Sacred ownership also yields120 gold per minute and can suppress demand for trade.

decision: Keep three starting villagers and current per-civilization gathering rates. Change Standard Sacred hold and finite reserves first; validate actual depletion with paid matches. Unvisited deposits never expire.
